name: omicsMIC
description: A benchmarking platform and dataset collection for comparing imputation methods on mass spectrometry–based omics (tabular) data.
reputation: Adopted by bioinformatics and mass-spectrometry researchers as a standardized platform for comparing imputation methods.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on tabular mass-spectrometry data; results are dataset- and preprocessing-dependent and sensitive to missingness patterns and instrument-specific artifacts.
